main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess next-14-bar return on forecast (grid bars, forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 to confirm (with top-minus-bottom third > 0), t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean excess 14-bar return

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and +2 (or undefined), so neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met.
reading: Situation taken as the component's raw signed run length below zero, expected side long; each coin's mean 14-bar return is the mean over the same non-overlapping 14-bar grid of all its windows, the slope's t is the OLS t of excess return on forecast, and the thirds are the n//3 lowest and n//3 highest forecasts after a stable sort.
